title: Authenticate Namibia–Angola reproduction inventories and contact operands
body:
Raised 2026-10-07 (America/Los_Angeles), post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1273, exact merge `6ddf130822bc28429a0841a272e4149b8c040019`, head `045af8b7c15a04d6305e05feae9e42fb70d8e4ff`. Preserve open #1268's source/physical/authority research and all later research (#1285/#1346/#1358/#1366/#1372/#1382/#1397), parent #1202 and other owners; this is one new additive reproduction/operand-identity erratum, not a takeover or extra PR under #1268's consumed budget.

**Observed incomplete-inventory false pass.** The complete unchanged `reproduce_full_product_comparison.py` is17,642bytes, SHA256 `59a109956ba0f43c9c10041a25ab9ed48214c5ab2ef894f6bac98401062203f6`. It reads materialized component/contact inputs, asserts counts21/10 and component validity, then records whatever local hashes it sees before/after. It does not require the independently pinned exact candidate/contact membership or complete canonical bytes before computing. The standalone documented command does not invoke the stronger consumed-source checker.

Actual isolated reproduction: preserve complete original packet and run unchanged code in a fresh owned packet with complete read-only original sources and all unchanged input bindings/pins. Replace only the last complete component feature by an exact duplicate of the first, preserving array length21. The full-product script actually returned exit0, wrote a6,302,501-byte report SHA256 `3af914d7eb0c90954af6834c9544a748d7d36ca301b7914fa7f90f564d80050e`, and reported the SAME headline summary as the genuine run (21components,10contacts,210pairs,49intersections,20NAM/21AGO positives,10differingcontacts). Only200distinct component/contact keys exist: one original component is omitted and10pairs duplicated. The separate unchanged `reproduce_source_geometry.py` rejected that fixture at its exact candidate-ID-set check and created no output. Thus its protection is not reached by the standalone full-product command. Expected: either supported standalone entry point rejects the changed full inventory before computation or output publication; actual complete IDs/canonical geometry/source/code pins must be anchored independently of editable local bookkeeping, not only count/preservation comparisons.

**Observed operand-description mismatch.** The original README says the full-product report compares each candidate to each of the10 *full* source contacts. The pair loop actually executes `subject = shape(contact["geometry"])` from the retained consumed contact GeoJSON, rather than the same-ID full-product feature. Independently computed all210pairs: they agree with consumed contacts;35pairs have a different intersection area when the corresponding full contact is used. Example `physical-component:12bedbd22f54e5f9495416ba68dea11a9873b873d4ed9f19433634b22734d4a0` / `gb:AGO:ADM2:16411231B28551746118834`: retained consumed-contact area0.0006121709531311945 square degrees, full-contact area0.0006016358539497586. All10consumed/full contact shapes differ topologically. Complete country-wide full-product scans are correct; this finding concerns pair operand identity and its description, not a territorial or water conclusion. The current-main README still contains the same full-contact statement. Correct the claim through an additive explicit erratum, retaining original reports; if adding an actual full-contact matrix, label both products separately and authenticate complete operands/rows.

**Independent actual evidence and limits:** all33changed head/merge files agree in whole bytes/Git identities (14,896,270B); all35ordinary whole-input pin aliases were independently authenticated against immutable Git bytes (45,120,445unique raw bytes); all21original components/10contacts unique in genuine input. Both actual unchanged scripts ran twice with Python3.12.14/Shapely2.1.2/GEOS3.13.1, with all4outputs byte-identical to retained reports. Independent exhaustive consumed/full source scans checked98saved per-hit rows, complete intersections and both differences, and every210pair relationship. A real invalid-component fixture and real missing-component fixture rejected before output; the reported invalid/missing controls are not being called false solely for their simplified receipt format. All885materialized originals/modes remain unchanged. No source acquisition, original rewrite, geography approval, fix or import was performed.

**Success criteria — one additive PR, new disjoint prefix:**
- Preserve every original input, source, code, report, subject/component ID, shape, date, historical result and uncertainty. Retain consumed NAM2007/AGO2018 versus same-release full sources as distinct operands. No originalpacket replacement, normalization, MakeValid, snapping, territorial/physical/legal verdict or source restoration.
- Before either supported standalone entry point computes, authenticate independently reviewed complete executed code and input bytes; require exact21unique candidate and10unique contact inventories/order plus real immutable source bindings. Missing/duplicate/omitted/changed inputs, mismatched whole source/code and coherent edits of untrusted local manifests must fail before a valid output appears. Do not rely on another optional command having run first.
- Bind each pair to exact named source vintage/subject geometry and require exactly210unique genuine pairs. Explicitly correct the historical consumed/full-contact wording. Retain historical reports and add an independently verified correctly named successor; never relabel consumed operands as full.
- Two genuine fresh complete runs must match the correct retained baseline (or a fully explained additive new full-contact artifact). Execute the real duplicate/omission fixture above, contact duplicate/missing controls, whole-input/code drift, invalid/missing geometry and existing-output/symlink/traversal rejection. Use fresh exclusively created owned outputs, retaining failed attempts and all originals. Independently check complete per-hit intersections/differences, source identities and membership rather than headline counts.
- Obtain distinct substantive exact-head source/implementation and applicable geometry review, focused source CI, ordinary serialized integration and complete byte/mode readback. This task grants no source/legal/physical truth, sovereignty, geography, import or publication approval and does not complete #1268/#1202.

**Dedup/ownership/readiness:** complete authenticated all-state inventory1435issue/PRentries in15pages (14x100+35), exact-family/duplicate-integrity searches and later#1285changed-file inspection show no matching repair. Current main `de506f51100568e150e51f2926a5259b71e55272` retains both exact affected script hashes; subsequent dated-reference tasks are independent research, not this integrity fix. No dependencies or original owner claims are taken. The new prefix is disjoint. Initially blocked pending shared read-only readiness/overlap review; urgency does not waive readiness or scientific gates.
